_meta.source: Lovable edit history, sbcheckout project, pulled 2026-07-02 via Lovable API
_meta.caveat: Timestamps are COMMIT times (UTC). Publish to production is a manual act by the advertiser and is NOT recorded here. publish_time_confirmed=false means treat commit time as earliest-possible-live.

deploy_events.relevance: captureTrackingParams lands on the exact day of the x6.5 checkout_rate step. Hypothesis: attribution-scope widening (tracking params passed through funnel -> Meta attributes more checkout events to ads), not a behavior change. Refines the May 24 ground-truth label to INTERNAL_FUNNEL (tracking/attribution-scope). Implication: pre-May-24 checkout_rate under-attributed; post-May-24 closer to true, ~4wk baseline.

verification.check: mirrored-step (notes_for_engine): if attribution-scope not behavior, purchases/CVR must NOT step on May 24 while checkout counts do, and purchases-per-checkout must show a mirrored down-step
verification.run: 2026-07-03 against data/meta/account_daily.csv, 4wk medians pre (2026-04-26..05-23) vs post (2026-05-24..06-20)

numbers.cvr_link_to_purchase: 0.0214 -> 0.0282 (x1.32 — no down-step; drifts with declining spend/clicks)
numbers.checkouts_at_boundary: May 23: 47, May 24: 287 — the step is entirely in checkout counting

verification.conclusion: The x6.5 step is a measurement/attribution-scope change, not a behavior change. Consistent with captureTrackingParams widening which checkout events Meta can attribute to ads.

deploy_events.relevance: Four-commit burst on /start (the checkout-entry origination surface) hours before/at the live case's onset. Primary INTERNAL_FUNNEL suspects for the Jun 25+ window, competing against EXTERNAL_DEMAND (World Cup peak week, USMNT prime-time loss Jun 25, post-Father's-Day gifting trough). RESERVED: feeds the Phase 4 blind backtest of jun25-checkout-entry-drop; not consumed by Phase 3 verdicts.

Post-onset advertiser response to the live anomaly (Hi-Res pricing test halted). Corroborates anomaly was real and noticed; NOT a cause candidate. Hi-Res had ~80% attach rate incl. abandoned checkouts — its removal may shift checkout composition from Jun 29 onward; split the live window Jun 25-28 (pre) vs Jun 29+ (post) if the anomaly persists.

notes_for_engine: SITE_DEPLOY is an evidence stream in engine/correlate.py: deploys join the ledger as INTERNAL_FUNNEL candidates with earliest-possible-live semantics (a deploy dated D can only explain anomalies with onset >= D; publish may be later than commit).
REACTIVE_ACTION tag implemented in engine/verdict.py; layer_candidate REACTIVE_ACTION deploys corroborate that an anomaly was real, never cause it.
May 24 mirrored-step verification: RUN 2026-07-03, CONFIRMED — see deploy-2026-05-24-tracking.verification.
